cards.content: **live**: the optimizer runs space heating: it writes the heat mode (Heat+DHW / DHW) and the Zone 1 water target; hot water stays with AppDaemon. **shadow** and **off**: the optimizer stops writing and the heat pump goes to Heat+DHW at 26 °C, so the room thermostats regulate (manual mode, and the emergency stop). Only this select can make the optimizer act.

**Floor** is a hard limit: a room whose thermostat reads below it forces heating at once, whatever the plan says (18 to 23 °C). **Day minimum** is the temperature the plan heats the room to inside the comfort window (18 to 26 °C); only hall / kitchen has a day minimum above its floor by default. The window is in hours, e.g. 12.5 = 12:30, the same for all rooms (start on weekdays, start on weekends, end). A changed day minimum or window takes effect at the next hourly plan (HH:10); a changed floor applies at once.
